title: English Practice Quiz 0929
description: A ten-question English practice quiz covering grammar, vocabulary and practical communication.

questions.question: Notice: 'Registration closes at 11:00 a.m.' When does it close?
questions.explanation: 11:00 a.m. is correct. The sentence or passage provides the relevant meaning and context.

questions.question: Nita must bring the original ID for verification. What must she bring?
questions.explanation: The original identity document is correct. The sentence or passage provides the relevant meaning and context.

questions.question: A delivery was postponed because heavy rain closed the road. Why was it postponed?
options: The road was closed after heavy rain
questions.explanation: The road was closed after heavy rain is correct. The sentence or passage provides the relevant meaning and context.

questions.question: Arun checks equipment at the beginning of every shift. When does he check it?
options: At the beginning of each shift
questions.explanation: At the beginning of each shift is correct. The sentence or passage provides the relevant meaning and context.

questions.question: Visitors must wear an identification badge. What should they wear?
questions.explanation: An identification badge is correct. The sentence or passage provides the relevant meaning and context.

questions.question: Meera called her supervisor because she missed the bus. Why did she call?
options: To report that she would be late
questions.explanation: To report that she would be late is correct. The sentence or passage provides the relevant meaning and context.

questions.question: The storeroom is locked after 6 p.m.; staff should contact the duty manager. Whom should they contact?
questions.explanation: The duty manager is correct. The sentence or passage provides the relevant meaning and context.

questions.question: A session starts at 2 p.m. and lasts 90 minutes. When does it end?
questions.explanation: 3:30 p.m. is correct. The sentence or passage provides the relevant meaning and context.

questions.question: Only sealed containers may go on the top shelf. Which is allowed?
questions.explanation: A sealed container is correct. The sentence or passage provides the relevant meaning and context.

questions.question: A report was returned because two pages were missing. Why was it returned?
questions.explanation: Two pages were missing is correct. The sentence or passage provides the relevant meaning and context.
